segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, yeah, thanks for making time. I saw your current term runs through September 30, so I wanted to talk through renewal and the extra seats your operations team asked about before we send the order form.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. We have 42 users today, and we’ll need 8 more by August 15. Mostly supervisors in the Ohio and Indiana sites.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, so 50 total seats starting August 15. The renewal would be 12 months, October 1 through September 30 next year. With the midterm add, your August invoice would show a prorated charge of $1,120, then the renewal is $58,500 for the full year.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Can you keep billing annual? Finance gets cranky if we split it monthly.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, annual billing stays the same. The only separate line is that August prorate for the 8 added seats. After that it rolls into the annual invoice on October 1.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: And support hours are unchanged? We have that standard response time, next business day, I think.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. Standard support, next business day response, same as your current agreement. No change to data retention or the onboarding package either. For the 8 new users, our enablement team can run a 45-minute admin session on August 13 or 14.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: August 14 at 10 central works. Also, can the invoice reference PO 44719? That’s the one procurement opened for this.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, PO 44719 on both the prorated invoice and the renewal invoice. I’ll include that on the order form notes too so billing has it from the start.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Send it to me and Marcus in procurement. If the numbers match what you just said, we can sign this week.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. I’ll send the order form this afternoon with 50 seats, August 15 effective date for the add-on, renewal dates October 1 to September 30, annual billing, and PO 44719. Once it’s signed, you’ll get the calendar hold for the August 14 training.
